    public static int Run(int input)
    {
        if (input < 1200) return RunSigned(input - 0);
        if (input < 2532) return RunUnsigned(input - 1200);
        return -5;
    }

    private static int RunSigned(int input)
    {
        var narrow = sizeof(nint) == 4;
        var index = SignedIndices[input];
        var value = narrow ? (nint)SignedValues32[index] : (nint)SignedValues64[index];
        var count = SignedCounts[input];
        var expectedError = narrow ? SignedErrors32[input] : SignedErrors64[input];
        try
        {
            var result = SignedOperations[input] switch
            {
                0 => unchecked(value << count),
                1 => unchecked(value >> count),
                2 => unchecked(value >>> count),
                3 => checked(value << count),
                4 => checked(value >> count),
                5 => checked(value >>> count),
                6 => unchecked(~value),
                7 => checked(~value),
                8 => unchecked(-value),
                9 => checked(-value),
                10 => unchecked(++value),
                11 => unchecked(value++),
                12 => unchecked(--value),
                13 => unchecked(value--),
                14 => checked(++value),
                15 => checked(value++),
                16 => checked(--value),
                17 => checked(value--),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input)),
            };
            if (expectedError != 0) return -1;
            var expectedResult = narrow ? (nint)SignedResults32[input] : (nint)SignedResults64[input];
            var expectedState = narrow ? (nint)SignedStates32[input] : (nint)SignedStates64[input];
            if (result != expectedResult) return -2;
            return value == expectedState ? 42 : -3;
        }
        catch (OverflowException) { return expectedError == 1 ? 42 : -4; }
    }

    private static int RunUnsigned(int input)
    {
        var narrow = sizeof(nuint) == 4;
        var index = UnsignedIndices[input];
        var value = narrow ? (nuint)UnsignedValues32[index] : (nuint)UnsignedValues64[index];
        var count = UnsignedCounts[input];
        var expectedError = narrow ? UnsignedErrors32[input] : UnsignedErrors64[input];
        try
        {
            var result = UnsignedOperations[input] switch
            {
                0 => unchecked(value << count),
                1 => unchecked(value >> count),
                2 => unchecked(value >>> count),
                3 => checked(value << count),
                4 => checked(value >> count),
                5 => checked(value >>> count),
                6 => unchecked(~value),
                7 => checked(~value),
                10 => unchecked(++value),
                11 => unchecked(value++),
                12 => unchecked(--value),
                13 => unchecked(value--),
                14 => checked(++value),
                15 => checked(value++),
                16 => checked(--value),
                17 => checked(value--),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(input)),
            };
            if (expectedError != 0) return -1;
            var expectedResult = narrow ? (nuint)UnsignedResults32[input] : (nuint)UnsignedResults64[input];
            var expectedState = narrow ? (nuint)UnsignedStates32[input] : (nuint)UnsignedStates64[input];
            if (result != expectedResult) return -2;
            return value == expectedState ? 42 : -3;
        }
        catch (OverflowException) { return expectedError == 1 ? 42 : -4; }
    }
